interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts to minimize conflict points and provide a more continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked mid-block crossings with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial curb cut to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle ingress/egress and use different paving materials to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Amenity Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip, street trees, or a furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-height lighting fixtures specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve visibility and security for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Implement a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and a more comfortable walking environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings near the bus stop.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to designate a safe crossing point between intersections.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and shorten crossing distances if traffic volumes allow.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Extend a level, clearly defined sidewalk across the driveways to prioritize pedestrian movement and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological protection for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility (continental) crosswalk across the main roadway to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance using curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and encourage drivers to yield.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Landscape Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Furniture
interventions.description: Provide benches or transit seating to accommodate pedestrians waiting or resting.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk along the entire block to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians separated from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Enhanced Landscaped Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide better physical and psychological separation from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Install a Landscape Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase the physical and psychological distance between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for protected bike lanes or wider sidewalks.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon) to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical protection and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical buffer, improve the microclimate, and naturally encourage slower vehicle speeds through psychological narrowing.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or into a new furniture zone to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Given the wide crossing distance and commercial land use, a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage should be considered.
